description_en: Queries the number of speeches that were broadcasted in a specific hour
description_zh: 调用该接口分页查询千里传音中共享播报的小时数据量
kebab_example: aliyun iot count-speech-broadcast-hour --share-task-code ebed9280_ba25_48df_80c2_0000 --iot-instance-id iot-2w0000 --query-date-time-hour 2020090919 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CountSpeechBroadcastHour

parameters.description_en:
The code that is used to share the speeches.

You can obtain the **code** on the **Shared Corpus Management** page of **Speech Sending Voice Broadcasting Service**.
parameters.description_zh:
语料分享任务的分享码。

您可在**千里传音语音播报服务**的**分享语料管理**页面，获取**分享码**。

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>  If your instance has an ID, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the request fails. If no Overview page exists or no instance ID is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

For more information, see the [Overview](~~356505~~) topic of IoT instances.
parameters.description_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>
